aurelm_engine_care.description: PHEV B48 operating hours, EV vs ICE split, cold hard starts, engine runs that never warm the oil, battery charge at engine starts and true oil degradation next to BMW CBS

aurelm_hybrid_cost.title: Hybrid Cost
aurelm_hybrid_cost.description: PHEV running cost calculator: live electric vs petrol cost per 100 km in 11 currencies, dynamic torque split, trip savings and a price editor for fuel and electricity
aurelm_hybrid_cost.author: custom

aurelm_myairplay.title: myAirPlay
aurelm_myairplay.description: The head unit as an AirPlay receiver for an iPhone: screen mirroring on the centre screen with the sound on the car's speakers (also with wireless CarPlay connected), and videos sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by the head unit itself, with their controls on the iDrive. The picture shows while parked. Needs the myAirPlay service.
aurelm_myairplay.author: custom

aurelm_tvhplayer.title: TVH Player
aurelm_tvhplayer.description: Tvheadend's TV channels on the centre screen: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then Watch, Channel + / -, or the channel list over the picture. Skip < > on the steering wheel changes the channel. The picture shows while parked, the sound plays on the car's speakers. The server transcodes (profiles mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced, AAC) and the profile goes down by itself when the internet is slow. Needs the TVH Player service.
aurelm_tvhplayer.author: custom

aurelm_wheel_heat.title: Wheel Heating
aurelm_wheel_heat.description: Steering wheel heating on/off from a favourite button: for a heated iDrive 8 (LCI) steering wheel without its own button, fitted to an iDrive 7 car
aurelm_wheel_heat.author: custom
